create_watson_distance_fft_loss: create a Watson perceptual distance loss based on FFT quantization with configurable blocksize and trainable parameters
build_color_wrapper_loss: build a color wrapper that extends a single-channel loss to work on RGB images via YCbCr decomposition
build_greyscale_wrapper_loss: build a greyscale wrapper that maps RGB or single-channel input to a 3-channel greyscale loss
run_blockwise_rfft2d: run blockwise 2D real FFT on single-channel tensors with configurable blocksize and stride
convert_rgb_to_ycbcr: convert RGB tensors to YCbCr color space using a learnable but frozen linear transform
